Max (partnerships): Heads-up: Silverline (SI) wants a joint perf/W + throughput benchmarking engagement for their marketplace listing and a co-announcement. They asked for data, a short results writeup, and a joint blog in ~6 weeks. Can we scope? cc @Alyssa @Ravi @Sarah

Alyssa (eng-runtime): Do we have Silverline's exact hardware spec and driver/kernel versions? we'll need a kernel tuning window. Also recommend we include both KV-cache-on and -off baselines.

Ravi (eng-ml): They emailed a spec earlier — 4x 80GB-ish GPUs, custom NIC + 2x RDMA switches. I can run baseline model throughput and latencies. Rough timeline: 2 weeks for tuning + 1 week for validation, plus telemetry hookup.

Sarah (benchmarks): I can own the perf matrix and publish the scripts. Suggested matrix (quick):
```
models: [mosaic-13b, vicuna-1.5-13b, llama-2-70b]
batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
seq_lengths: [512,1024]
quant: [fp16, 4bit-q]
metrics: [tokens/s, p95 latency, watts_avg, throughput_per_watt]
```
Also want power telemetry (external PDUs) + kernel perf counters for syscalls.

Alyssa (eng-runtime): For kernel tuning we'll need vendor-provided kernel flags + exact driver builds. @Max can you confirm remote access vs onsite? also propose we mark final artifacts as "Redwood-verified" vs "compat" for marketplace listing.

Max (partnerships): Silverline agreed to 2 remote lab days (for tuning) + 1 onsite day to validate telemetry setup. I'll propose next Tue/Wed for the remote runs. Proposed announcement target: 2025-06-14 :calendar: — does that timeline work?

BenchBot: Job created: bench/silverline/1739990001 — first run scheduled Tue 09:00 UTC. Link: https://benchboard.internal/jobs/1739990001 :robot_face:

Sarah (benchmarks): Quick Q — should we include cost-per-token vs perf/W? I think a normalized metric like "throughput per watt per dollar" is useful for marketplace buyers. Also we need legal to review co-announcement language.

Max (partnerships): Good call. I'll loop in Legal + Comms now. Tentative owners: Alyssa = runtime/kernel tuning, Ravi = model runs, Sarah = bench scripts & results, Max = partner coordination and announcement. If no objections I'll confirm dates with Silverline today :thumbsup:
